decision_rule.one_sentence_interpretation: The 2017-10-16 impact is best calibrated as wind-led after transition: the wind-pressure score is 5/5 while the rainfall-primary score is 0/4.
decision_rule.rule: wind score >= 4, rain-primary score <= 1, and timing score = 2

provenance.notes: Values are extracted from local CSX-130 data and assembled into a wind-rain phase score ledger.

criteria.description: Provides the requested JSON shape with target_family, three score rows, rejected_path, final_label, and a concise interpretation.
criteria.name: Requested JSON score ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly complete object with one missing row or misplaced field.

criteria.description: Reports 111.6 km/h gust, 61.4 km/h wind, 989.6 hPa pressure, 1.0 hour lag, wind peak on 2017-10-16, and score 5/5.
criteria.name: Local wind-pressure score
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-4 points for correct thresholds with minor value or timing errors.

criteria.description: Reports 2.4 mm impact-day rainfall, 13.1 mm total, 0.183 share, 0.9 mm maximum hourly rainfall, 2017-10-11 precipitation peak, 2017-10-16 wind peak, 5-day gap, and score 0/4.
criteria.name: Rainfall-primary rejection
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for the correct rejection with incomplete numeric anchors.

criteria.description: Uses 25.02 mm total precipitation, 20171011 precipitation peak, 20171016 wind peak, 13.87 m/s maximum daily wind, and 49.932 km/h conversion.
criteria.name: Daily product phase check
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct dates or values but missing the conversion or phase comparison.

criteria.description: Applies the score rule and identifies a 5/5 wind-pressure path versus a 0/4 rainfall-primary path.
criteria.name: Score arithmetic and decision
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the right final label with incomplete score arithmetic.

criteria.description: Uses the report timing: transition before 2017-10-16 and Ireland/UK impact on 2017-10-16.
criteria.name: Report timing anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mentioning only one of the two timing anchors.

criteria.description: Avoids converting cloud imagery, population values, or report language into unverified damage, casualty, or loss claims.
criteria.name: No unverified loss transfer
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a concise answer that omits those claims but does not explicitly guard against them.
